notes: This file defines the various stats, pools, weights, and derivatives that characters can have in the Unbound TTRPG system. Each stat has a name and description. The stats are used to calculate die pools used by nearly all abilities.

stats.name: Body
stats.description: Body represents a character's physical strength and endurance. It is used for tasks that require brute force, such as lifting heavy objects, breaking through barriers, or engaging in melee combat.

stats.name: Spirit
stats.description: Spirit represents a character's vitality, energy, and will to survive. It is used for tasks that require perseverance, such as enduring pain, resisting disease, or maintaining focus under pressure.

stats.name: Mind
stats.description: Mind represents a character's mental acuity, knowledge, and problem-solving abilities. It is used for tasks that require critical thinking, such as solving puzzles, recalling information, or analyzing situations.

resources.name: Health Pool
resources.description: When HP is reduced to zero, the character is incapacitated.

resources.name: Stamina Pool
resources.description: When SP is reduced to zero, the character is exhausted.

resources.name: Mental Pool
resources.description: When MP is reduced to zero, the character is mentally drained.
